characterList.description: A park ranger at Indiana Dunes National Park. He is a middle-aged man with short dark hair, a mustache, and is wearing a park ranger uniform which consists of a green shirt with patches, dark green cargo pants, a brown belt, brown hiking boots, and a straw ranger hat.
characterList.name: Ranger Rafi Wilkinson

content_metadata.description: A virtual hike led by Ranger Rafi Wilkinson, exploring the diverse flora, unique landscapes, and ecological significance of the Tolleston Dune Trail.

qAndA.answer: Fire helps to maintain the oak savanna by preventing the growth of a dense understory that would block sunlight from reaching the wildflowers and grasses. It also helps to recycle nutrients, stimulate new growth, and create a more diverse habitat for plants and animals.
qAndA.question: Why is fire so important to the oak savanna habitat?
